one_liner: HubSpot is a customer platform connecting marketing, sales, service, and data tools with comprehensive REST APIs and MCP servers.
access_notes: Free API access is available out of the box with self-serve account creation and no credit card required.
verdict_reason: HubSpot provides fully documented REST APIs, official MCP servers, self-serve credentials, and a free permanent tier.

evidence.snippet: HubSpot secures its APIs with apiKey, http, and oauth2 across 5 declared security schemes
To use the HubSpot MCP Server, you must be on the new HubSpot Developer Platform.
